description:
Manage Focus publicsharedreports with the following actions:

- **open-public-shared-report**: Open Public Shared Report Publicsharedreports. (data: token*)
- **profitability-public-shared-report**: Profitability Public Shared Report Publicsharedreports. (data: include_dicts, payload*{chart_key}, response_format, token*)
- **query-public-shared-report**: Query Public Shared Report Publicsharedreports. (data: include_dicts, payload*{chart_key}, response_format, token*)
- **workload-public-shared-report**: Workload Public Shared Report Publicsharedreports. (data: payload*{chart_key}, token*)

Pass the action-specific fields under `data` (required fields are marked with *).
Mutations require a confirm_token handshake: call without confirm_token first to receive a token, then call again with the token to confirm.
Optional dry_run: true validates input and returns { dry_run, operation, input } without calling the API.

action.description: One of: open-public-shared-report, profitability-public-shared-report, query-public-shared-report, workload-public-shared-report

confirm_token.description: Mutation confirmation token from previous call

data.description: Action-specific payload. See each action's parameters in this tool's description; pass dry_run: true to validate it without calling the API.
